speaker: press
text: A reporter cuts across the West Wing walkway, recorder already running. "I have leaked audio of one of your cabinet secretaries admitting the administration diverted infrastructure funds," they say. "I'm running it tonight. Do you have a comment, or should I quote your silence?"

choices.text: Threaten the journalist with national security injunctions.
Promise an internal inspector general investigation.
Offer an exclusive interview on another topic to bury the story.
